security.csp: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self' 'wasm-unsafe-eval'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' data:; font-src 'self'; connect-src 'self' ipc: http://ipc.localhost; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'self'

bundle.shortDescription: Personal data studio for preparing AI pretraining data
bundle.longDescription: Import text data, clean it with normalizers, Gopher-style quality filters and deduplication, inspect what was removed and why, and export training-ready JSONL, Parquet or tokenized shards. Runs locally.
